# Plate: a wide shallow 12-sided dish (the served pancakes stack on it). Up Z.
new
material new Plate --base-color 1.0000 0.9686 0.8941 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name Plate --vertices 12 --radius1 0.3 --radius2 0.48 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0.035
material assign Plate
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export plate.glb
